product.name: Gozney Arc XL Propane Outdoor Pizza Oven, Heats up to 950F - Bone | Make 16" Pizza in 60 Seconds, Precision Control Lateral-Flame, Digital Display, Removeable 0.8" Stone Floor
features: [16" PIZZA IN 60 SECONDS]: The Arc XL portable outdoor pizza oven features an innovative lateral rolling flame system that replicates a traditional wood-fired oven. It delivers evenly distributed heat for a crispy, restaurant-quality 16" pizza in just 60 seconds, perfect for pizza parties

[PRECISION FLAME CONTROL]: Featuring Gozney’s revolutionary burner system and intuitive controls, this gas pizza oven makes it effortless to manage temperature for consistently perfect crusts and evenly cooked toppings, making it easy an fun to cook all kinds of pizza, steak, fish, vegetables, and more.

[UNBEATABLE HEAT RETENTION]: Reach and hold 950F/500C pizza after pizza. Removeable 20mm stone floor and dense 2-layer insulation enables this oven to reach higher temperatures faster and stay hotter longer, even through multiple bakes.

[COMPACT OUTSIDE, SPACIOUS INSIDE]: Arc XL gas pizza oven brings Gozney’s renowned design ethos into a sleek form that’s compact outside yet big on cooking space inside, making it easy to cook and turn pizza with room to spare, whether you're a professional chef or beginner.
[COMBINE WITH]: Complete your setup with the Gozney Arc + Arc XL Stand, the water resistant Cover, Arc Mantel, a placement peel, and a turning peel for an elevated outdoor cooking experience.
